digest.component_or_area: store write path (event_append, batch commit, reconciler)
propositions: Directory created with os.makedirs outside write lock before first event file written causes orphaned empty ticket directories when writer is interrupted (observed in production: 8 debris dirs with illsuited-erect-ibis signature)
Atomic publish requires staging directory and CREATE event file together in a single os.rename operation under the write lock
Staging directory naming convention .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex> leverages existing fsck dot-prefix exclusion rule to make temp paths invisible to scanner checks without code changes
Batch commit path and reconciler inbound/dispatch alert paths share the makedirs-then-die signature and must be converted alongside single-event path to close the vulnerability everywhere
Stale staging directories from dead processes are removed by bounded best-effort sweep reusing lock_owner v2 stamp (host + pid-namespace + start-time) to avoid pid recycling confusion
